newsitem.title: USA: Criticare Systems affiliate signs license.
newsitem.headline: Criticare Systems affiliate signs license.

text.p: Criticare Systems Inc said its Immtech International Inc affiliate signed a license for exclusive rights to a new class of pharmaceutical compounds.
Criticare said the compounds, used to treat a variety of fungal, parasitic and bacterial diseases, were developed by a research consortium led by the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

Immtech is filing applications with federal regulators for clinical trials of several drugs, including a treatment for cryptosporidium parvum, a parasite that causes debilitating diarrhea in immune-suppressed AIDS and cancer patients.
Criticare is a developer of medical monitoring equipmnent and is Immtech's largest stockholder with a 32-percent stake.
Its shares closed up 3/8 Tuesday at 5-1/8.
